items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I found out that we were to have a 17-piece band... They had a young fellow that was from Kansas City, and everybody called him Junior... There was Charlie Parker and Junior on alto saxophones.

ctx.x: But back to where we were, about the telegram that I got from Billy Eckstine to come to New York and join this band. Immediately, I began to pack my suitcase, and called Tommy Potter, and we got together and went to New York. We had a rehearsal in Ringold(?) Studios, I think it was on a Wednesday. I'll have to look at the telegram;; I think it was in June, about June 6th or something, of 1944. And the rehearsal was called something like 1 o'clock.

So we get into New York, and we go up to this rehearsal, and here are all... There were a lot of musicians there. I found out that we were to have a 17-piece band. So I'm being introduced to the different people in the band. The reed section was Charlie Parker on alto saxophone. They had a young fellow that was from Kansas City, and everybody called him Junior, but I can't remember what his real name was. [JOHN JACKSON] There was Charlie Parker and Junior on alto saxophones.
